card.name: Identifier punctuation in reference lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces or digits right before a number in citation identifiers, such as the colon after ISSN, doi or PubMed, and the digit inside a DOI. It also fires on page abbreviations in reference entries.

modes.label: Colon or space before ID number
modes.description: The colon or space after ISSN, eISSN, doi or PubMed, just before the number begins.

modes.label: Digit inside a DOI
modes.description: A zero partway through a long DOI string in a reference.

modes.label: Page marker in citation
modes.description: The abbreviation pp after a volume or issue number, before page range.

card.writes: It seems to push the next token toward an identifier number string and away from recruitment words.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a journal reference where an ISSN, DOI or PubMed number is about to start.
